description: Canonical source of truth for the create-loop slash commands. The standalone installer (bin/create-loop.js) and the render step generate host-specific command files (.opencode/command/*.md, .claude/commands/*.md) from these entries. Edit commands HERE, then run `create-loop render` to regenerate the committed host artifacts.

commands.description: Admit and create a create-loop using the default v1 protocol or explicit opt-in v2 protocol.
Advance an existing v1 or v2 create-loop after detecting and validating its protocol.
Resume a v1 checkpoint loop or v2 journal loop from a blank session.
Show a read-only status snapshot for a detected v1 or v2 create-loop.
